title: Subject profile (subjects/<name>/profile.json; protocol.md, Protocol v3)
description: constructor.params names are the sigma.ctor keys (not necessarily the Solidity parameter names). Everything subject-specific the judge path and the adversary need: the contract, the spec harness header and probe signatures, the value pools, the callable ABI subset, the fixed setup and the observation. Its sha256 is pinned in protocol.json.

file.description: File in subjects/<name>/; also the solc unit name and the spec's import.

constructor.description: The exact constructor every spec must declare (lint S4).

probes.description: Allowed check_* parameter lists; parameter names are disjoint across signatures. sigma.probe carries the arguments of all of them.

senders.description: Names in pools.address that may send transactions and deploy.

calls.description: Per-function overrides: sender kinds and one kinds list per parameter (tools/seqgen.py docstring).

functions.description: The callable ABI subset the adversary and properness search draw from.

sender.description: A sender pool name; default: the sigma's deployer.

setup.description: Fixed transactions sent by the deployer right after deployment. They are part of every sigma's canonical form and hash: sigma.setup carries them verbatim (validated to equal this list with sender = sigma.deployer), so witnesses and properness pairs in a bundle's evidence layer carry them and the verifier replays them.

keys.description: One list of pool names per getter parameter; the getter is read for every combination.

kinds.description: typed-v2 kinds (tools/seqgen.py docstring), picked uniformly from the list (repeat an entry to weight it). Numbers: decimal literals, small, wad, ray, rad, random, [+-]unit_le_N, frac_prev, repeat, negate. Addresses: pool names, self, hoped, any. bytes32: pool names, any. Senders: sender names, deployer, any. Part of the distribution id.
